desc:
🎨 PAINT + DECORATE + UPGRADE 🎨

Turn empty and messy places into something amazing! 🏠🏢🏥🍽️

Paint walls, place furniture, and transform each location from start to finish. Earn money as you work and use it to upgrade your tools, unlock better equipment, and complete jobs faster!

🎨 Paint and customize walls!
🛋️ Place furniture where it belongs!
🔧 Upgrade your tools!
💰 Earn money from every job!
🏢 Renovate different locations!
✨ Transform every place into something new!

What will you transform next? 🎨
